_readme: Human-verified starting point for the 'Ceasefire in force' indicator (option A). Read by scripts/update.py via scripts/ceasefire_indicator.py.

status: yes | no | unknown | hidden.  yes/no = shown as green/red and HELD up to hold_days (default 60) while nothing contradicts it.  unknown = grey until the live check (both AI models + 2 independent sources) can say.  hidden = row not shown.
verified: the date YOU checked it (YYYY-MM-DD). To change a status later: edit status, evidence and verified (set verified to today). A newer baseline always overrides the stored result.
evidence: exact quotes copied from the cited pages (shown to visitors under 'Show the sentences behind this').
subject: lowercase words; only search results whose title/url/opening text contain one of them can influence this conflict's live check.
Re-verify every entry at least every 60 days: after that the row turns grey on its own.
